title: Miracles of Jesus - Faith of a Roman Officer

videos.title: The Thankful Leper + More Stories of Jesus Healing

textBlocks:
In todays true Bible story you will hear how a Roman Officer 
has SO MUCH FAITH in JESUS authority.
Authority - means that Jesus was very powerful.

This man tell Jesus NOT to come to his house where the sick servant is
BUT JUST TO SAY THE WORD, and he knows his servant will be healed!!!!

He knew who Jesus was
and that God had sent Him to earth.
THE MIRACLE IS NEAR THE END OF THIS VIDEO - 15:00
